Masayoshi Son’s $20 million bet on Alibaba became one of the greatest venture capital investments in history. 💰 In 2000, Son met a relatively unknown Jack Ma and reportedly spent only a few minutes with him before deciding to invest. Instead of relying entirely on financial projections, Son believed in Ma’s vision and the potential of his company. SoftBank eventually secured roughly a 30% stake in Alibaba. What started as a $20 million investment later became worth billions as Alibaba grew into one of the world’s biggest technology companies. Interestingly, Son initially wanted to invest $40 million, but Jack Ma reportedly accepted only $20 million because he believed that was enough to build the business. The lesson? Sometimes the biggest investments are made before the numbers look obvious. Would you invest based on a founder’s vision—or wait for the financial data to prove it? Manufacturers. Negotiations. Production. Freight. Customs. Port fees. Final delivery. And baby… there are PLENTY of opportunities to make an expensive mistake in between. Ask me how I know. 😭😂 I’ve been importing inventory for years, and learning how to source overseas completely changed the way I was able to grow my rental inventory. So if importing is something you’re seriously considering, learn the process BEFORE you start sending people your money. The Easiest Way to Find the Right Qwen Image Model Alibaba's latest image model, Qwen Image 2.1, generates pictures and edits them using just ten reference images in a single step. This is where things get messy for developers, though. The model is huge, with a text encoder that takes up nearly eighteen gigabytes of storage on its own. The GitHub repository, Awesome Qwen Image, solves this by acting as a single map for every version of the model. It lists official downloads, lighter versions for your laptop, and tools that improve your prompts. You do not need to guess which file to download. The repository organizes everything by hardware and task, so you can find the right version quickly.
